# نخبة Nukhba — Premium Web Agency in Tripoli, Libya

> Nukhba (نخبة) is a premium web design and development agency based in Tripoli, Libya. We build fast, luxury-branded websites, e-commerce stores and booking systems for Libyan businesses — delivered in 7 to 21 days with Next.js, 90+ Lighthouse scores, full Arabic (RTL) and English support, SEO and AI-search optimization, WhatsApp integration and crypto payment options.

## Key facts

- Agency: Nukhba (نخبة), Tripoli, Libya — Al Jumhouriya Street
- Founded focus: premium websites for companies, shops, restaurants, clinics, real estate and e-commerce in Libya
- Delivery: 7 days (vitrine), 10 days (vitrine+), 14–21 days (e-commerce/booking)
- Guarantees: 90+ Lighthouse performance score, mobile-first responsive design, 2 revision rounds, 30–90 days free support
- Languages: Arabic (primary, RTL) and English; French-speaking team
- Contact: WhatsApp +218 91 234 5678 — email hello@nukhba.ly — open Saturday to Thursday, 9:00–18:00
- Payments: USD pricing with indicative LYD equivalent; bank transfer, cash, and crypto via NOWPayments (full payment or 2–3 installments); $1 refundable scheduling deposit

## Services

- Vitrine (showcase) websites: exclusive brand design, up to 5 crafted pages, mobile-first, essential SEO, contact form + WhatsApp, delivered in 7 days
- Vitrine+ websites: up to 10 pages plus blog, appointment/table booking, Google Maps & Analytics, advanced speed optimization, bilingual AR/EN, delivered in 10 days
- E-commerce & booking systems: full online store or reservation system, cash on delivery + transfer, product/room/service management, easy admin dashboard, automated WhatsApp notifications, advanced SEO, delivered in 14–21 days
- Standalone services: restyling old websites, adding new sections (portfolio, blog, booking, mini-shop, FAQ), pitch decks and slides, branding & logo design, high-conversion landing pages, fix & optimization audits

## Frequently asked questions

- How long does a website take? 7 to 21 days depending on the package; timeline shared upfront with daily WhatsApp updates.
- Does the price include hosting and domain? One year of ultra-fast Vercel hosting plus domain connection is included; the domain itself (~50 LYD/year) is registered in the client's name and connected for free.
- Can clients edit content themselves? Yes — an easy admin dashboard allows editing texts, images, prices and adding products or posts without a developer, with training included.
- What about payment and installments? A $1 deposit reserves the slot (deducted from the final price), then 50% at signing and 50% on delivery; bank transfer, cash or crypto installments accepted.
- Will the website appear on Google? Yes — professional SEO structure including titles, sitemaps, structured data and 90+ speed scores, built to rank locally in Tripoli.
- What happens after delivery? 30–90 days free support depending on the plan, then optional monthly maintenance with updates, backups and security.
